g.text: Composition differs; band-H effects vary across scenes. A small pooled mean does not establish equivalence.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5b677a

g.text: A: static = 2 seeds per scene averaged (Taming arm); SLAM = all submaps of one source run per scene (40 / 28 / 26). Gaussian-SLAM deletes opacity < 0.1 while mapping.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5b677a

g.text: B: 8 grad-arm models, 20 % of each band removed without fine-tuning, test views; positive favours trace. Band H removes 2.7–4.3 % of a map, band L 10.3–12.6 %. Lines: pre-set thresholds B1 (≤ 0.25) and B2 (≥ 1.0).
